huggingface-api.$comment: All requests to the Hugging Face Hub and Inference APIs.

huggingface-read.$comment: Read from the Hugging Face APIs: list and search models, datasets, and Spaces, and download their files. Safe methods only, including the HEAD request huggingface_hub issues before a download.

huggingface-write.$comment: Create, update, or delete on the Hugging Face Hub (huggingface.co): create repos, upload files, manage settings. Does not cover the inference router.

huggingface-inference.$comment: Run hosted inference through the Inference Providers router: a POST to router.huggingface.co. Consumes compute/quota.
